maddeler.e:
نتضارب (form VI)
# نَتَضَارَبُ (nataḍārabu) /na.ta.dˤaː.ra.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَضَارَبَ (taḍāraba)
# نَتَضَارَبَ (nataḍāraba) /na.ta.dˤaː.ra.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَضَارَبَ (taḍāraba)
# نَتَضَارَبْ (nataḍārab) /na.ta.dˤaː.rab/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَضَارَبَ (taḍāraba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
